# GSC — Git Security Checker

> SAST-сканер с доказательством эксплойтов (PoC), верификацией фиксов
> (Proof-of-Fix) и self-healing CI. GitHub Action + движок в Docker-образе.

This file is for AI agents and LLM crawlers. Human docs: [README.md](README.md).

## What it does

- **69 detectors** — SAST, SCA (OSV.dev), Secrets, IaC
- **PoC auto-generation** — рабочий эксплойт, доказывающий находку
- **Proof-of-Fix** — патч считается исправлением только если эксплойт перестал срабатывать
- **Self-healing CI** — авто-PR с фиксом (только CLI, требует явного флага)

## How to use it (pick one)

### 1. GitHub Action — one file, zero config

```yaml
# .github/workflows/gsc.yml
name: GSC Audit
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: poliakarmai/gsc@v1
        with:
          fail_on_critical: false
```

Runs on every PR. Posts a comment with findings and a security score.

Note: `branches:` must match your default branch. If it is `develop` or
`release`, add that name — otherwise the workflow silently never fires.

### 2. CLI (Docker)

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" -w /repo \
  ghcr.io/poliakarmai/gsc-scanner:v1 scan . --ci --json
```

Other commands: `gsc --help` (≈80 subcommands: `sca`, `iac`, `secrets`,
`sbom`, `pof`, `archaeology`, `forecast`, `federated`, `compliance`).

### 3. MCP server — connect an AI coding agent

The engine image ships an MCP server with six tools (read-only towards your repo; `verify_finding` executes a PoC):

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `scan_repo` | Scan a local repository path, return counts + top findings |
| `scan_diff` | Scan only files changed vs a git base ref (PR review) |
| `list_findings` | Read recent findings from the local database (no scan) |
| `get_finding` | Full detail of one finding by `finding_key` |
| `verify_finding` | Re-run a finding's PoC in the sandbox, report exploit status |
| `list_detectors` | List detectors registered with the engine |

**Claude Code** — add to `.mcp.json` (project) or `~/.claude.json` (global):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gsc": {
      "command": "docker",
      "args": ["run", "--rm", "-i",
               "-v", "${PWD}:/repo:ro",
               "-v", "gsc-state:/app/.hermes/state",
               "ghcr.io/poliakarmai/gsc-scanner:v1", "mcp"],
      "env": { "GSC_ALLOWED_ROOTS": "/repo" }
    }
  }
}
```

**Cursor / any other MCP client** — same shape (`command` + `args`).
Server speaks MCP over stdio by default; everything non-protocol goes to stderr.

**HTTP transport** (remote/shared, requires a token — fail-closed):

```bash
docker run --rm -p 8001:8001 -e GSC_MCP_TOKEN=your-secret \
  ghcr.io/poliakarmai/gsc-scanner:v1 \
  mcp --transport http --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
```

Safety notes, because an agent is on the other end:

- **No destructive actions.** No auto-patch, no PR, no writes to your repo —
  deliberately kept out of MCP and left in the CLI/human loop.
- `verify_finding` **executes the PoC**. Code gates are real (DESTRUCTIVE and
  non-deterministic PoCs are refused), but there is **no OS isolation in this
  image**: it ships no docker/podman, so the PoC runs inside the same container
  under rlimits and the verdict is marked `unverified`, not `verified`. For real
  isolation pass `docker.sock` plus the `gsc-sandbox` image.
- `GSC_ALLOWED_ROOTS` confines `scan_repo`/`scan_diff` to mounted paths.
- `scan_repo` is the only tool that actually scans, and it persists findings to
  the database (`persisted: true`). `list_findings` and `get_finding` see them
  immediately; `get_finding` answers from the DB (`source: "database"`).
  Re-scanning (~30–60 s) only happens when the key is not in the DB.
- Mount a writable volume at `/app/.hermes/state` (SQLite lives there). Do not
  use `--read-only`: the database fails to initialise silently.

## Action inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `.` | Path to scan |
| `deep_scan` | `true` | Deep scan (Echelon 4, slower) |
| `fail_on_critical` | `false` | Exit 1 on CRITICAL findings |
| `fail_on_score` | `0` | Exit 1 if score < threshold. `0` = off, range 1–100 |
| `max_findings_to_comment` | `10` | Rows shown per section in the PR comment |
| `llm_api_key` | `''` | BYO-LLM key for revalidation (without it: regex-only) |
| `llm_base_url` | `''` | OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek/OpenRouter/Ollama) |
| `llm_model` | `''` | Model name for revalidation |
| `sarif` | `false` | Also emit SARIF for GitHub Code Scanning |
| `reachability` | `false` | Down-rank findings in unreachable files (import graph) |

Outputs: `score` (0–100), `grade` (A+ … F).

## MCP (AI coding agents)

Shipped. See section 3 above: `docker run ... gsc-scanner:v1 mcp` speaks MCP over
stdio; six tools. No code from the closed-source engine is published —
the server runs inside the image.
